universe_rationale: Two existing stocks and two existing unleveraged ETFs within the existing four-symbol contract; selected before performance calculation. Closed surviving universe, not a point-in-time reconstruction of all listings.
model_availability_clock: Counterfactual historical training cutoff; fitted artifacts are created during the current recorded run, not a claim that this model existed or was deployed in 2023
entry_execution_scope: A modeled immediate limit at the next scheduled bar open. The ceiling is derived from approved risk, notional and cash before reading that opening price. An opening above the ceiling is NO_FILL; no later intrabar fill is invented. OHLCV does not certify actual executable size or queue priority.

temporal_design.deviation_from_walk_forward: One fixed fit per asset and estimator avoids extra searches and isolates the models. No rolling reoptimization is claimed; later rolling research would consume a separately retained attempt.

target.definition: Net return on entry notional of the fixed native BASELINE campaign, including modeled trading friction and observed cash-dividend entitlements. Quantity four for label construction; no portfolio capital is allocated to independent training labels.
target.known_at: Maximum of exit knowledge and corporate entitlement knowledge

features.proxy: bid/ask = last known close * (1 -/+ assumed spread_bps / 20000)
features.training_row_overflow: HARD_FAIL; no sampling or adaptive deletion

admission.ranking: Predicted net return, only among signals with the identical decision timestamp; alphabetical deterministic tie-break

cost_evidence.taxes: PRE_TAX; no tax or withholding estimate
cost_evidence.funding: Long-only, fully cash-reserved; no cash interest, borrowing or rebates assumed
cost_evidence.idle_weekends: External budget is allocated per exchange session, not a claim that infrastructure is free on weekends

statistics.unit: Whole portfolio aligned session log return
statistics.block_rationale: Five consecutive sessions retain overlapping positions of at most 72 hours and weekly clustering; longer-regime dependence remains a limitation
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni lower-tail alpha=0.05/12 for six net-growth endpoints and six paired Ridge-minus-native/SVR-minus-native/SVR-minus-Ridge endpoints; all six measured policies retained
statistics.effective_observations: Report distinct sessions, block count and dependence estimate; trade count is not a guarantee
statistics.prior_search_limitation: This local twelve-endpoint correction cannot repair missing provenance or fully correct unenumerated earlier searches

budget.verification_fit_explanation: Eight primary fits plus eight deterministic pre-replay integrity recomputations; one complete exact reproduction repeats those sixteen without selecting new parameters

level7_real_gate: UNCHANGED: historical conditional results cannot grant REAL level 7
